dirSub: Search by college name, AICTE code, city, or state to check approved seat limits.
portalsSub: Select your role below to sign in or check records.
portal1Desc: ਨਵੇਂ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਜਿਸਟਰ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਬਾਕੀ AICTE ਪ੍ਰਵਾਨਿਤ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ।
portal2Desc: ਪ੍ਰਵਾਨਿਤ ਸੀਟ ਸੀਮਾ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਾਲੇ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਡੁਪਲੀਕੇਟ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਆਈਡੀ ਫੜੋ।
portal3Desc: ਤਸਦੀਕ ਕੀਤੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਡਿਗਰੀਆਂ ਜਾਰੀ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਜ ਸੀਟ ਸੀਮਾ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ।
portal4Desc: ਆਪਣਾ 12-ਅੰਕਾਂ ਦਾ APAAR ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਦੇਖੋ, ਕਾਲਜ ਸੀਟ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਚੈੱਕ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਡਿਗਰੀ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰੋ।
portal5Desc: ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਡਿਗਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਦਾਖਲਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ। ਲੌਗਇਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
footerOversight: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Nelson Mandela Marg, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070.
s1_body: Pick any of India's 22 official languages from the language menu in the header (highlighted now). This tour follows your choice.
s2_body:
The problem: AICTE usually only knows how many students a college has, not who they are. So the records are incomplete and hard to check.

Our idea: give every student one ID, their APAAR ID, and let everyone work from the same trusted record.
Institution → Upload → Check → Verify → AICTE records → Analytics → Authorised lookup

This tour shows every point in the problem statement, plus a few extras we added.
s3_story: Meet Sneha, a student in Pune, and Dr. Joshi, her college principal. Today, AICTE hears how many students a college took in, but never who they are.
s3_body: Follow Sneha from her first day to her first job. You'll see how one 12-digit APAAR ID ties together her college, the regulator, her university, herself and her employer.
s4_body: This Guide button stays on every page. Tap it to replay the story, or ignore it and explore on your own. Both are fine.
s5_title: ਭਾਗ 1: ਡਾ. ਜੋਸ਼ੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਲਜ ਦੀ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ
s5_story: Admissions are over. Dr. Joshi has to tell AICTE more than just a headcount.
s5_body: Approved seats, students actually admitted, extra seats, NRI, OCI and foreign students. Everything in one place.
s6_title: ਸਨੇਹਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ
s6_story: Her whole batch is uploaded, and every student is tied to their own APAAR ID.
s6_body: Colleges upload a simple spreadsheet (CSV) once admissions close, and can upload again to fix or update records.
s7_title: ਗਲਤੀਆਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਫੜੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ
s7_story: Someone mistyped an ID, and the list now has 187 students for 180 seats.
s7_body: Wrong or missing IDs, double entries and too many admissions are flagged right in the browser, before anything is sent.
s7_try: ਅਜ਼ਮਾਓ: 187 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਸੂਚੀ ਲੋਡ ਕਰੋ
s8_title: ਅਗਲੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਟਾਈਪ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਨਾ
s8_story: Next year, the college's own software will send all this automatically.
s8_body: College systems and the AICTE portal can send the same data through a standard connection (an API).
s9_title: ਸੀਟ ਮੀਟਰ ਲਾਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ
s9_story: Dr. Joshi sees the problem and fixes it before anyone else notices.
s9_body: The dashboard shows, live, how full each college is compared to its approved seats.
s10_title: ਭਾਗ 2: ਡਾ. ਮਹਾਜਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਹਨ
s10_story: In Delhi, AICTE's Dr. Mahajan can watch every college at once.
s10_body: Seats, admissions and categories across the country, with colleges over their limit listed first for inspection.
s11_story: Rahul Sharma took seats at two colleges and was about to get a scholarship twice.
s11_body: Both admissions carry the same APAAR ID, so the system flags it automatically.
s12_story: Policy teams no longer wait a year for paperwork.
s12_body: One click gives ready reports for policy, accreditation and inspections.
s13_story: Four years later, her university issues her degree and links it to her APAAR ID.
s13_body: Each degree is digitally signed and linked to the one before it, so even a tiny edit shows up. You can run the check yourself.
s14_title: ਭਾਗ 4: ਸਨੇਹਾ ਕਾਬੂ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਦੀ ਹੈ
s14_story: A company wants to see her records. Nobody can, unless she says yes.
s14_body: Under India's data protection law, students choose who sees their data. She creates a one-time pass for one company and one purpose.
s15_story: No SMS code to steal. She just proves it's really her.
s15_body: Students approve with their phone's fingerprint or face unlock (a passkey), so nobody else can approve on their behalf.
s16_title: ਉਸਦੇ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਉਸਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਚੱਲਦੇ ਹਨ
s16_story: Sneha earned credits every semester, and they follow her wherever she studies.
s16_body: Credits from every semester are tracked toward the degree, including for students who join in the second year after a diploma.
s17_story: The company's HR team checks Sneha's degree. No letters, no weeks of waiting.
s17_body: Verifiers enter the APAAR ID and say why they're checking. Every check is recorded.
s18_title: ਇੱਕ ID, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਤੇ ਛਪੀ ਹੋਈ
s18_story: The answer comes back in seconds.
s18_body: The record shows her APAAR ID next to her college student ID, and certificates print with both.
s19_story: HR only needs to know her marks are above 7.5, not her exact marks.
s19_body: Verifiers can ask a yes-or-no question like "CGPA at least 7.5?" and get a signed answer without seeing the actual grades.
s20_story: Then someone hands HR a photo of a marksheet showing a higher grade.
s20_body: An AI that runs inside the browser reads the marksheet photo and compares it with the official record. Nothing is uploaded.
s20_tried: Forged sample loaded. Press Run to scan it.
s21_story: Finally, Sneha needs a printed copy for her file.
s21_body: The result prints as a signed certificate designed to meet India's rules for electronic evidence.
s22_title: ਕਹਾਣੀ, ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਕੁਝ ਆਇਆ
s22_story: One ID tied together five people and removed the paperwork between them.
s22_c1: APAAR ID ਨਾਲ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਡੇਟਾ ਅੱਪਲੋਡ ਕਰੋ
s22_c2: ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ, ਭਰਤੀ, NRI, OCI ਅਤੇ ਵਿਦੇਸ਼ੀ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ
s22_c3: ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਜਾਂਚ ਅਤੇ ਦੁਹਰਾਈਆਂ ਐਂਟਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ
s22_c4: AICTE ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਲਈ ਲਾਈਵ ਡੈਸ਼ਬੋਰਡ
s22_c6: ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਹੋ ਸਕਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ
s22_c8: ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ, ਭੂਮਿਕਾਵਾਂ, ਆਡਿਟ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ
s22_extras: ਵਾਧੂ: 22 ਭਾਸ਼ਾਵਾਂ, ਉਂਗਲ ਦੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਨਾਲ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰੀ, ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ ਟਰੈਕਿੰਗ, ਹਾਂ/ਨਾਂਹ ਸਬੂਤ, ਨਕਲੀ ਮਾਰਕਸ਼ੀਟ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ
s23_body: How did we do? It takes 20 seconds.

home_step2_desc: The system blocks extra admissions above the approved limit and flags duplicate IDs across colleges.

home_step4_desc: Employers and citizens can check the degree and admission status in one click.

home_rule2_desc: Digital degrees verified on this portal are valid for all government and private jobs under the IT Act, 2000.
